svg.title: Teacher sequence, data stores, checkpoint transitions, and logits/KL divergence diagram
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: teacher stack at upper left with diagonal Teacher Sequence arrow to central teacher block; left cylindrical data store with Ds, Di, De and two small illustrative image thumbnails; central stacked state blocks Tt, St, S(t-1) connected by black/gray/red/dotted arrows; right red/gray logits bars connected by black arrows and teal KL divergence links; bottom legend.

g.desc: Transparent editable base frames for aligned diagram regions; sibling frames are separated and contained within the full canvas frame.

Upper-left teacher sequence frame inventory: four overlapping light-blue teacher sheets, a front Tt sheet with a snowflake, and a black diagonal arrow labeled Teacher Sequence pointing toward the front sheet and then to central Tt.

Left data frame inventory: purple transparent cylinder containing top region Ds and two white disks labeled Di and De. Two thumbnail images sit on the cylinder's right edge; the lower thumbnail has a red outline and feeds red checkpoint arrows.

Central flow frame inventory: origin is the central teacher Tt card. It receives a black teacher-sequence arrow from above/left and gray input arrows from the left. Below it are orange St and blue S(t-1), with red checkpoint-change paths from De/photo area and a dotted downward relation between St and S(t-1). The section is vertically partitioned by the three state cards, with arrows exiting right toward logits.

Right logits frame inventory: red logits from De and dark gray logits from Di are vertical bars aligned in rows. Teal diamond-ended KL divergence links connect corresponding consecutive logits vertically between rows.
Bottom legend inventory: dotted gray checkpoint arrow, red bar labeled logits from De, teal diamond-ended KL divergence line, and gray bar labeled logits from Di. Items are aligned in two columns.
